title: GET /s/{token} request
description: shareLinks.open (jovra-gateway; caller: anyone with the link). No cookie, no account; an expired, revoked or unknown token is the same 404. A request descriptor: pathParams, query, headers and body. No body. Header names are canonical; compare them case-insensitively. A real request may carry other headers (User-Agent, Accept-Encoding) that the contract does not use.
